faq_heading: Questions manufacturers and distributors ask about an AI SEO agent

faqs.q: Does an AI SEO agent work for a technical product range?
faqs.a: Yes, as long as it writes from facts you approve. You share datasheets, grades, applications and common buyer questions once, and the agent turns them into clear pages. Technical claims are never invented, and you can review any page.

faqs.q: Will it help us rank for product names and part numbers?
faqs.a: It can help with the questions buyers type around them, such as which grade suits an application or how two options compare. Pure part-number pages depend on your catalogue, so those are agreed with you first.

faqs.q: We sell through dealers. Is SEO still useful?
faqs.a: It can be. Buyers who find clear answers on your site learn who you are before they talk to a dealer, and distributors can win enquiries from buyers in cities and countries their sales team never reaches.

faqs.q: How do buyers reach us once they find a page?
faqs.a: Every page ends with a clear way to start a conversation on WhatsApp. Enquiries come to you as normal chats, so your sales team can follow up the same day.

faqs.q: How soon will we see results?
faqs.a: Expect the foundation in the first month, early movement in impressions after that, and enquiries building over three months or more. We aim to show you a first demo within 7 days.
